claims.claim_text: The target paper presents Robertson--Sanders--Seymour--Thomas as the simpler proof and immediate algorithmic predecessor for four coloring.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Robertson, Sanders, Seymour, and Thomas ... found a simpler proof and proved in 1997 that a 4-coloring can be found in quadratic time.
claims.inclusion_reason: Immediate predecessor named explicitly by the target as the baseline being improved.

claims.claim_text: The target says RSST-STOC reduces problem size by an additive constant in linear time, leading to an overall quadratic algorithm.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: RSST-STOC ... shows how we can benefit from obstructing cycles. The general conclusion is that we can reduce the problem size by an additive constant in linear time, so the overall algorithm is quadratic.
claims.inclusion_reason: Direct target-text statement about the predecessor algorithmic regime.

claims.claim_text: The target says it uses exactly the same discharging rules as Steinberger.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: As our discharging rules are exactly the same as those in Steinberger ...
claims.inclusion_reason: Explicit imported framework from the target text.

claims.claim_text: The target says theorem (i) is a more specific version of Steinberger's positive-final-charge theorem and uses the same proof.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Theorem ... (i) is just a more specific version of Theorem ... from Steinberger ... We use the same discharging rules, and the proof is the same as in Steinberger.
claims.inclusion_reason: Explicit theorem-level dependency stated in the target text.

claims.claim_text: The target says Appel and Haken found a proof of the Four Color Theorem in 1976.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: ... until Appel and Haken found a proof ... in 1976.
claims.inclusion_reason: Target-text historical benchmark for the proof tradition.

claims.claim_text: The target contrasts its stronger objective with Appel--Haken's use of 1482 reducible configurations.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Appel and Haken ... used 1482 reducible configurations.
claims.inclusion_reason: Target-text comparison point for configuration scale.

claims.claim_text: The target says Birkhoff proved that a minimal counterexample to the Four Color Theorem is an internally 6-connected triangulation.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Birkhoff proved ... that a minimal counterexample to 4CT is an internally 6-connected triangulation.
claims.inclusion_reason: Target-text statement of an inherited structural fact used in the genealogy.

claims.claim_text: The target says Birkhoff proved the Birkhoff diamond D-reducible.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Birkhoff ... proved that the configuration consisting of two adjacent triangles with all four vertices of degree 5 is D-reducible ... known as the Birkhoff diamond.
claims.inclusion_reason: Target-text statement of an early D-reducibility antecedent.

claims.claim_text: The target says Franklin's work already gives a coloring reduction procedure from obstructing cycles.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: It has been known since the work of Franklin that obstructing cycles give a coloring reduction procedure.
claims.inclusion_reason: Target-text basis for Franklin as an obstructing-cycle precursor.

claims.claim_text: The target says Franklin's classic 6-regular configuration is not D-reducible, motivating its own larger D-reducible 6-regular configuration.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: The classic 6-regular configuration is Franklin's ... but it is not D-reducible. However, we discovered the larger D-reducible 6-regular configuration ...
claims.inclusion_reason: Target-text contrast that helps define the novelty boundary, while remaining target-mediated.

claims.claim_text: The target identifies the move from one reducible configuration or obstructing cycle to linearly many such local reductions, especially in flat regions, as its main novelty.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: In this paper, we show that every planar triangulation contains not only one, but linearly many ... The main insight is that reducible configurations or obstructing cycles also appear in large 'flat' parts ... This is the most significant novel contribution of this paper.
